_README: THE SINGLE MACHINE-READABLE HOME FOR FACTS THAT MANY DOCUMENTS REPEAT.
Change a value HERE, then run:  python system/sync.py --write
Every AUTO block in every document is regenerated from this file. Never hand-edit those blocks.
An AUTO block looks like:   <!-- AUTO:palette START -->  ...generated...  <!-- AUTO:palette END -->
WHAT BELONGS HERE: a fact that is (a) current, and (b) repeated in more than one live document.
WHAT DOES NOT: history (changelog, progress, qc-log, job tickets are append-only records of what
was true THEN), and anything with exactly one home already (that home stays the source of truth
and other docs POINT to it).
THIS FILE IS EMPTY BECAUSE THIS IS A FRESH INSTALL. Add your first client's repeated facts when
you onboard it. NOTE: the block builders in system/sync.py (palette, demo roster, summary) were
written for the originating agency's own brand and are keyed to a client id. Adapt them to your
own keys before you place your first AUTO block, or sync.py will not find what it expects.

_why: Paths referenced ON PURPOSE even though they do not exist. sync.py skips these.
Keep this list SHORT and justified: a long allowlist means the checker has been talked
_link_check_allowlist.system/jobs: The job-ticket folder. The law forbids placeholder-only folders, so it is created by the first ticket, not shipped empty.
_link_check_allowlist.infra/fal/.env: The generation API key. Created by hand on each machine, never committed.
_link_check_allowlist.infra/postiz/.env: Publishing credentials. Created by hand on each machine, never committed.
_link_check_allowlist..mcp.json: MCP servers and their keys. Copy .mcp.example.json to it and fill in locally.
